name: LTX-2.5 · Restore (archive footage)

video_restore.note: Video in, the same shot as a clean, colour, higher-resolution capture: removes compression damage, tape and sepia casts, flicker. Colour is inferred from content; the user's words steer it.

description: Restoration and colourisation of archive footage with Lightricks' Restore IC-LoRA on LTX-2.5 distilled through the tiled fusion sampler (qHD tiles). Made for the cloud GPU.

sourceVideo.note: Archive or low-bitrate footage, progressive. 49 or 97 frames per pass are best. The output canvas is FullHD by default in the source's aspect.

$NEGATIVE.note: Things that must not be invented. Has no effect at cfg 1 (the distilled schedule).

$CHECKPOINT.note: chosen from requires.checkpoints, never by the caller

$OUTPUT_SIZE.note: FullHD (default), 4K or 8K: the canvas the clip is lanczos-resized to and refined at.

models.note: Encodes the empty prompt only, once per run.

compatibility.note: Full-HD 145-frame clips need an H100/B200-class GPU (model card). Meant for RunPod (RTX PRO 6000 / H100).

nodePacks.name: ComfyUI-LTXVideo
nodePacks.note: Lightricks' own pack; the IC-LoRA nodes are not in ComfyUI core.

notes: Built by tools/build_ltx25_iclora_templates.py; edit that script, not this file.
Weights are gated on Hugging Face: each IC-LoRA repo has its own license gate to accept.

lines.text: natural colour, daylight, sharp photographic detail, crisp faces and clothing texture, natural grain, high resolution footage

prompt.note: Describe period, place, light and clothing: colour is a semantic decision the prompt steers. Keep it generic across the frame.
